thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate detected for tenant acme-corp in dedicated-pool-3. Pager: @Mia. Observability: spikes in runtime errors + anomalous billing meter spikes. Root TS: 2024-07-12T21:07:14Z

Mia: ack — joining now. what are we seeing for customer impact? can they be served by fallback? :rotating_light:

Sam: I see repeated 502/504s from runtime-proxy v2.4.3 and unusually high token counts in the usage stream for tenant "acme-corp" (billing ingestion). Looks like a meter duplication event — tokens reported >> expected.

Elena: customer on call (ACME CS lead). They're seeing failed responses and noticed a large usage spike in their internal monitoring. They're worried about billing — pls advise.

Jonah: jumping in (runtime oncall). quick triage: runtime logs show identical request IDs being processed twice within ~200ms sometimes. Proxy trace shows retries that shouldn't happen. Hypothesis: proxy retry race -> duplicate forwarding -> double-count in meter.

Mia: mitigation options: 1) isolate acme-corp to a safe fallback pool 2) throttle 3) enable per-tenant dedupe at proxy. Which is fastest?

Jonah: fastest is per-tenant dedupe at proxy (config toggle) + redirect to redwood-2-medium for heavy requests so we reduce load. I'll push dedupe toggle now.

Sam: applying proxy dedupe toggle: ``curl -X POST https://proxy-admin.local/toggles/dedupe -d '{"tenant":"acme-corp","enable":true}'`` -> response 200. Also applied request-rate cap: ``limit=10rps`` for that tenant.

Sam: meter sample from billing stream (anonymized):
```
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-corp",
  "window_start": "2024-07-12T21:00:00Z",
  "tokens_reported": 120000,
  "tokens_expected_est": 12000,
  "model": "redwood-2-large"
}
```
This shows ~10x over-reporting coincident with the error spike.

Elena: ok sending customer a short note: "we're mitigating, throttling to preserve service, and pausing billing for the spike while we investigate". They asked for a reconciliation and ETA.

billing-bot: Billing team notified (ticket BL-4572). Requested: freeze auto-invoice for tenant acme-corp and mark usage for manual review.

Mia: oncall handoff note: I'm handing to Sam at +20m for 6h. I'll remain reachable. Sam — please coordinate billing and CSE.

Sam: confirmed handoff. running live checks. After dedupe toggle, errors dropping from 18% -> 2% in the last 4 minutes. Meter ingestion now shows tokens trending back to expected.

Jonah: found root cause signal: cache layer (kv-cache v1.9) had a race where cache-miss path dispatched a recompute job but also re-emitted the same request to the meter pipeline in the failure path. Patch introduced in 2024-06. Repro locally with race harness.

Sam: mitigation status: proxy dedupe + per-tenant cap + redirect to redwood-2-medium applied. No further duplicate IDs observed in traces.

Elena: customer update sent: "we paused billing evaluation and are preparing export of all usage for reconciliation. Will share S3 link and a proposed refund/credit if overcharge confirmed." They want a 1:1 call with Billing + CSE + Eng.

billing-bot: Billing team ETA: hold placed. Need export of per-request usage + digests to reconcile. Opened BL-4572 with priority P1.

Sam: starting export job for per-request digests (range 2024-07-12T20:50 -> 2024-07-12T21:20):
```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-usage-exports/acme-corp/2024-07-12/ /tmp/acme-export --recursive --profile prod-exports
```
ETA ~2h for full export; preliminary sample in 15m.

Jonah: next steps for postmortem/action items: 1) revert patch or fix kv-cache race 2) add meter dedupe at ingestion layer (idempotency keys) 3) add canary for dedicated-pool rollout 4) billing safety: auto-hold on sudden >3x spikes for tenant-level usage.

Mia: agreed. I'll create the incident card and assign owners. @Elena pls draft customer timeline. @billing-bot pls coordinate BL-4572.

Elena: drafting now. Customer requested reconciliation + temporary credit. I'll include proposed times for a call.

Sam: export started. preliminary logs attached to BL-4572. Will produce digests and link when ready.

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated (auto-note). Error rate falling, duplicate meter events stopped after proxy dedupe. Please keep updates in this thread for the postmortem. :white_check_mark:

Mia: closing handoff. Sam owns next-steps and PM follow-ups. I'll patch the oncall notes. Thanks team.

Sam: will follow through with exports, billing reconciliation, and a short RCA doc. Adding this to the incidents tracker.

Elena: scheduling customer call for tomorrow 10:00 PT.

billing-bot: BL-4572 updated with export link when available. Billing will propose credit if overcharge confirmed.

Jonah: adding a quick quarantine test to CI to catch similar cache race — I'll include a reproducer.

Mia: great work — nice quick mitigation.
